Garlic Butter Pasta

This creamy garlic butter pasta comes together in under 20 minutes and uses pantry staples you probably already have on hand. It's the kind of weeknight dinner that feels indulgent without requiring much effort, and leftovers reheat beautifully the next day.

Ingredients

  • 8 oz spaghetti
  • 4 tablespoons butter
  • 4 cloves garlic, minced
  • 1/4 cup grated parmesan
  • Salt and pepper to taste

Instructions

  1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti according to package directions until al dente.
  2. While the pasta cooks, melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat and add the minced garlic, cooking until fragrant, about 1 minute.
  3. Drain the pasta, reserving a half cup of the pasta water, then add the pasta directly to the skillet with the garlic butter.
  4. Toss to coat, adding reserved pasta water as needed to loosen the sauce, then stir in the parmesan and season with salt and pepper before serving.
